short_description: Munich-based German artificial-intelligence startup founded in 2018 by Pavol Sikula (Chief Executive Officer) and Matthias Ruppel (Chief Technology Officer) that built a text-based digital assistant for consultants, executives and business-services professionals, delivering research, translation, data analysis and presentation tasks over email and Microsoft Teams from a GDPR-compliant Germany-hosted platform. Acquired by Berlin-based PowerPoint-productivity vendor think-cell in September 2023; prior investors publicly reported include Fostec Ventures (pre-seed lead), and angels including the founders of Zenloop, Flaconi, Flink and Kartenmacherei.
